mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, title, content, notice_type, sort_order, status, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_shop_notice WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND (start_time IS NULL OR start_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY sort_order DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_shop_notice (tenant_id, title, content, notice_type, sort_order, status, start_time, end_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{noticeType}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_shop_notice SET tenant_id = #{tenantId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, notice_type = #{noticeType}, sort_order = #{sort}, status = #{status}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
